programme.title: Hansan: Rising Dragon
programme.desc: Korean admiral Yi Sun-sin and his fleet battle against the attack of the Japanese navy and achieve an epic win through a secret weapon.

programme.title: Java Heat
programme.desc: After a devastating suicide bombing at a high-profile party in Java, a detective and an undercover agent join hands to track down the culprits behind the terror attack.

programme.title: The Thin Red Line
programme.desc: American soldiers face a brutal battle on a Pacific island during World War II, confronting not only a fierce enemy but also their own personal struggles with fear and morality.

programme.title: Vincent N Roxxy
programme.desc: An unlikely romance develops between Vincent, a loner, and Roxxy, a rebel, while they are on the run to save their lives. However, their violent past seems to catch up with them wherever they go.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Three siblings operate an illegal moonshine business using their restaurant as a front. Things take a turn when the oldest brother, Forrest, refuses to pay a bribe to a corrupt lawman.

programme.title: Extraction
programme.desc: When Leonard Turner, a former CIA operative, is held captive by a group of Russian arms dealers, his son, Harry Turner, sets out to find and rescue him.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania: Transformania
programme.desc: When Van Helsing's invention goes awry, Johnny turns into a monster and Dracula becomes human. Later, they embark on a journey to find a cure before their transformations become permanent.

programme.title: Never Back Down 2: The Beatdown
programme.desc: Four fighters from different backgrounds come together to train under a former MMA star. Ultimately, they have to fight each other and also the traitor who hides among them.

programme.title: The Gunman
programme.desc: Terrier, an assassin, kills the minister of mining in Congo before going into hiding. Years later, he returns to Congo as a charity worker, unaware that he is the target of a hit squad.

programme.title: Underworld: Rise of the Lycans
programme.desc: Lucian, a werewolf slave, convinces his Lycan compatriots to rebel against their vampire masters, who are led by Viktor, a powerful vampire elder. This leads to a full-fledged war between the two.

programme.title: The Possession of Hannah Grace
programme.desc: Megan, a former police officer who works in a morgue, is tasked with moving a disfigured body. However, she sees terrifying visions that make her suspect that the corpse is possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: When a meteor crashes on Earth, it brings with it single-celled organisms which evolve rapidly. Later, four professionals stumble upon these aliens and must stop their growth to avoid an invasion.

programme.title: Grown Ups
programme.desc: Five childhood friends take their families for a weekend trip to a lake house in their hometown, where they reunite to attend the funeral of their former high school basketball coach.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: When a drug lord offers a huge reward to anyone who can get him out of prison, the SWAT team in Los Angeles, USA is tasked with preventing the escape.

programme.title: The Animal
programme.desc: Marvin wakes up after an accident and discovers that he has powerful animal-like abilities. While his new skills gain him much fame, they also put him in embarrassing situations.

programme.title: THE FOOLISH ANGEL DANCES WITH THE DEVIL
programme.desc: Lily, sleepless after last night with Akutsu, dozes off in class. He appears in her romance game dreamcould this be her chance to win him over?

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 1
programme.desc: Ryomen Sukuna.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Itadori wakes up in an unfamiliar room and before him rests Gojo Satoru, a teacher at Jujutsu High, who declares Itadori's secret execution has been decided upon. Gojo presents Itadori with two options. He can be executed immediately, or he can hunt down all 20 of Ryomen Sukuna's fingers and die after absorbing all of them...

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Itadori, Fushiguro, and Gojo head out to meet up with the third first year, Kugizaki Nobara. Thereafter they head to an abandoned building where Gojo tasks Itadori and Kugizaki with exorcising the curses lurking inside. Once inside the building Itadori and Kugizaki split up to look for the curses and Kugizaki faces off against a cunning curse that takes a child hostage.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: An emergency breaks out at a juvenile detention center and Itadori, Fushiguro, and Kugisaki are dispatched to handle it. Their mission is to verify and rescue any survivors left inside with the curse womb that could develop into a special grade cursed spirit. Itadori and the others storm in to find a merciless reality waiting for them. Immediately thereafter, Kugisaki disappears and the special grade cursed spirit appears beside Itadori and Fushiguro.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: After retreating outside the juvenile detention center, Fushiguro notices the death of the special grade cursed spirit. The very next moment Ryomen Sukuna appears beside him, and rips Itadori's heart from his body to take him hostage. Fushiguro begins fighting Sukuna to prevent Itadori from dying when he regains control, but he becomes painfully aware of the difference in their strength.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Gojo stews in his frustration over Itadori's death. Both Fushiguro and Nobara are depressed by their teammate's death, but they begin their special training with the second year students to get stronger. Meanwhile, Geto and the others begin to make their move. And during all of that, the dead Itadori...

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 7
programme.desc: While in transit Gojo is suddenly attacked by the special grade cursed spirit Jogo. After launching several attacks that never hit--Jogo comes face to face with Gojo's strength. In an instant Gojo returns to Jujutsu High and easily picks up mid-training Itadori which causes Jogo's anger to erupt. He takes his next move, to which Gojo—.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 8
programme.desc: While they're training for the exchange event, Kugisaki and Fushiguro come face to face with Kyoto's Jujutsu High second years - Zen'in Mai and Todo - who challenge them to a fight. Todo overwhelms Fushiguro with physical strength. Meanwhile, Kugisaki is disgusted by Mai's comments and says something to provoke her.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 9
programme.desc: Yoshino Junpei skips school to go to a movie theater, but then he witnesses the classmates who bullied him getting their faces transfigured and dying. He chases after the culprit and calls out to them. Later, Itadori and the ex-salaryman first-grade jujutsu sorcerer, Nanami Kento, storm into the scene of the crime within the theater and encounter two cursed spirits.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 10
programme.desc: Itadori is placed in charge of investigating Yoshino, so he turns to his assistant supervisor, Ijichi for a plan. Their plan to have a low-level curse attack Yoshino and gauge his response fails, so Itadori speaks to him directly. After watching Itadori ultimately drive away the teacher he hated, Yoshino decides to hear him out. Meanwhile, Nanami has pinned down Mahito's base and he delves into the underground sewers to face Mahito.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 11
programme.desc: Mahito corners Nanami, but he releases the limiter on his cursed energy, destroying the wall of the underground channel with Ratio Technique: Collapse, and causing rubble to rain down upon them. Meanwhile, Itadori makes contact with Yoshino and they hit it off after talking about movies. He meets Yoshino's mother, and after being invited into their home, more is revealed...

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 12
programme.desc: Mahito deftly uses Yoshino's admiration toward him to make him fight Itadori. Yoshino races toward vengeance and Itadori exchanges blows with him to try and make him explain his motive, which leads to him learning the cruel truth from Yoshino's lips.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 13
programme.desc: Nanami steps in at the last second to save Itadori from Mahito's blow. Then Itadori and Nanami match their attacks together to ensure they can exorcise Mahito. Mahito pulls out his transfigured humans in an attempt to mentally drive Itadori into a corner, but Itadori manages to overcome them. As Mahito grows trapped under their rain of blows he senses his pending death.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 14
programme.desc: After escaping from Itadori and Nanami, Mojito reunites with Geto and the others to try and move their plan forward. Meanwhile, Jujutsu High is about to host its Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event. Fushiguro, Kugisaki and the second years Maki, Toge, and Panda all meet up to greet Todo and the other Kyoto students on arrival. Sparks immediately start to fly when Gojo rushes in late to the meetup and presents his surprise.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 15
programme.desc: The Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event's group battle begins. Kyoto's Todo rushes to attack the Tokyo students, but Itadori takes on the role of stopping him and faces off against him. Itadori's overwhelmed by Todo's power, but suddenly Todo asks him what kind of woman is his type.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 16
programme.desc: Todo points out that Itadori's Divergent Fist is a technique that won't work against special grades. When Itadori genuinely accepts his advice, Todo decides to face him and guide him with his full might. Meanwhile, Kugisaki picks a fight with Kyoto's Nishimiya. From the sidelines Mechamaru fires an attack at Panda, sparking the start of their battles with Kugisaki against Nishimiya and Panda against Mechamaru.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 17
programme.desc: The Exchange Event's Group Battle continues! Maki and Miwa face off, but Miwa can't hide her surprise at the overwhelming strength Maki displays despite her grade ranking. At the same time, Kugisaki pursues Nishimiya as she flies around on her broom. Nishimiya talks about Mai's hardships and what it's like to live as a female jujutsu sorcerer, but Kugisaki cuts her off and counterattacks. Then Mai reveals herself.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 18
programme.desc: Battles are starting to be decided in different locations on the first day of the Exchange Event. Fushiguro faces off against Kamo, the heir to one of the three major clans. Kamo uses Blood Manipulation, a technique that controls his own blood, while Fushiguro fights him with shikigami and martial arts.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 19
programme.desc: The special grade cursed spirit, Hanami, suddenly intrudes on the Exchange Event. Fushiguro, Inumaki, and Kamo face off against Hanami, defending themselves as they race to cross the veil. The three are driven into a corner when Maki joins the fight and strings together a chain of attacks in combination with Fushiguro. However, even with that, they're still forced into dire straits by Hanami's overwhelming prowess.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 20
programme.desc: Itadori and Todo join the battle against Hanami. Itadori lands his Black Flash, and his Todo unleashes his cursed technique as they keep up their combo attack. Alongside his \"brother\.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 21
programme.desc: Gojo has driven Hanami away with his overwhelming strength. Mahito reunites with Hanami, who's on the verge of death, after stealing Sukuna's fingers and the Special Grade Cursed Object, Death Painting Wombs 1 through 3. They're steadily making progress with their preparations to seal Gojo Satoru on October 31st. Meanwhile, those with Jujutsu High are unable to discern the cursed spirits' objective.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 22
programme.desc: Three men have died under similar circumstances from a cursed spirit. Investigators discover the victims all attended the same middle school, so Itadori, Fushiguro, and Kugisaki are dispatched to investigate. Once they arrive, they learn it was Fushiguro's old middle school. There they learn that the victims were all found unconscious beneath Yasohachi Bridge, a local haunted location. They also learn that Fushiguro's older sister, Tsumiki, is caught up in this incident as well.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 23
programme.desc: In addition to the curse of Yasohachi Bridge, Itadori, Fushiguro, and Kugisaki face off against Kechizu, one of the special grade cursed objects: Cursed Wombs: Death Paintings. The three start fighting within the barrier of Yasohachi Bridge's curse, but something suddenly seizes Kugisaki's arm and drags her outside the barrier. Itadori and Kechizu chase after her, leaving the barrier. Left behind, Fushiguro quickly takes of the Yasohachi Bridge curse--until he witnesses a shocking sight.

programme.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 24
programme.desc: The Cursed Wombs: Death Paintings, Eso and Kechizu, face off against Itadori and Kugisaki, but the two begin to rot after they're bathed in the blood of Eso and Kechizu. Driven into a corner, Kugisaki hammers a nail into herself to activate Resonance and start a game of chicken with the brothers. Itadori refuses to stop and continues to attack Kechizu, but-- This whole mission began with one of Ryomen Sukuna's.

programme.title: Solo Leveling Season 1 Episode 1
programme.desc: Over a decade ago, a pathway called a \"gate\" appeared, which connected this world to another dimension. People called those who fought against the monsters on the other side of the gate \"hunters.\".

programme.title: Solo Leveling Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Jinwoo and the others are exploring a low-ranked dungeon, and they step into a temple dungeon they've never seen before. What awaits them inside are three rules, along with a monster that sends them into despair beyond fear.

programme.title: Solo Leveling Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Jinwoo remained alone in the temple dungeon to save what's left of his party.

programme.title: Solo Leveling Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Jinwoo enters an instance dungeon from the entrance of a subway and levels up as he defeats monsters.

programme.title: Solo Leveling Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Hwang Dongsuk’s party is short on their member quota to raid a C-rank dungeon. Jinwoo, along with another member, Yoo Jinho, join them in bolstering their numbers and the party makes easy work of the monsters and proceeds on.

programme.title: Solo Leveling Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: It seemed like the raid of the C-rank dungeon was going well.

programme.title: Solo Leveling Season 1 Episode 7
programme.desc: While clearing the C-rank dungeon, Jinwoo annihilates every member of Hwang Dongsuk's party, who had tried to kill him for personal gains.

programme.title: Solo Leveling Season 1 Episode 8
programme.desc: Jinwoo has been looking for the item displayed in the window, the Elixir of Life, for his sick mother. But the quest to obtain this item is too difficult for Jinwoo that it would be nearly suicidal to attempt.

programme.title: Solo Leveling Season 1 Episode 9
programme.desc: At B20:C20r's Association, Jinwoo is reunited with Song Chiyul, Lee Joohee, Kim Sangshik, and Kang Jeongho, who have survived the Cartenon Temple. And he goes to explore the D-rank dungeon with Kang Taeshik and the others from the Surveillance Team.

programme.title: Solo Leveling Season 1 Episode 10
programme.desc: After the battle with Kang Taeshik, Jinwoo survives the tragedy once again. However, Woo Jinchul warns him that Hwang Dongsoo, an S-rank hunter, may be after Jinwoo's life.

programme.title: Solo Leveling Season 1 Episode 11
programme.desc: Out of the blue, a \"job-change quest\" pops up in Jinwoo's window. Feeling that it may help him get stronger, Jinwoo sets foot into a gate.

programme.title: Solo Leveling Season 1 Episode 12
programme.desc: Despite being cornered, Jinwoo manages to defeat the Crimson Knight, Igris. Without a moment of respite, another window pops up to announce a new quest.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1)

programme.title: Supertato (S2)
programme.desc: Evil Pea steals Supertato's brand new Tato Car but doesn't realise that the Grape Kids are in the back seat. Supertato has to get the Grape Kids back to safety and save his car.

programme.title: 滿天神佛 / Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: 一次驅鬼時，青年術士魯興與友人因功力太差被女鬼戲弄險告喪命，幸得連大師施法幫助，才將女鬼驅逐。於是二人馬上拜他為師。友人意外地被日本忍者所殺，魯興決定要學習絕世茅術，與大師一起對付殘暴的忍者，因而引發終極亂鬥！.

programme.title: 花月良宵 / Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: 魔術師陳子新和歌女張曉萍一次避雨，誤闖豪華大宅，曉萍被屋主以爲她是失散孫女，對她甚爲喜愛，可是引起富豪外甥不忿，設計害子新和曉萍。萍將計就計，把陰谋揭發，成功成立了歌舞團。.

programme.title: 椰林春戀 / Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: 富商之子平建人由於不願繼承父業，決定跟女朋友蘇詠蘭自開旅行社，招攬女教師董嫻芸和四個少女學生遊覽馬來西亞。詠蘭在旅途中眼看女學生李愛蓉癡戀建人，又誤會建人與嫻芸相戀，傷心失望離去。後來發現嫻芸早有情人梁茂夫，一場誤會始告冰釋。愛蓉得悉建人將與詠蘭結婚，精神失常，駕車撞山受傷昏迷…….

programme.title: 七俠五義 / King Cat
programme.desc: 太師之子在陳州貪贓枉法，私吞皇糧，被包拯當場斬首處死。太師知道後大怒，並令人刺殺包拯，幸得展昭及時阻止，救回他一命。皇上的珍品被偷的同時，宮中又發生謀殺案，於是，皇上限定包拯要在十天內破案。展昭馬上出發搜捕兇手。包拯和展昭最後可否如期破案？.

programme.title: 南少林與北少林 / Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: 滿清入主中原後，北少林為免遭剿滅，只好受命派出弟子到清軍府擔任教頭，誰知抵達後，始知府中已有南少林教頭；期間將軍挑動兩派人不和繼而公開比武互相殘殺，後南派因弟子傷亡而與北派交惡，展開一番互相殘殺...

programme.title: 血手印 / The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: 窮書生林肇德與富翁的女兒訂親，但富翁卻因肇德家道中落，反對婚事。肇德為迎娶其女兒，決定要上京考取功名。上京赴考前，肇德去見未婚妻，怎料卻碰上婢女滿身鮮血伏屍後花園。因不慎留下血手印於門上，他更被誣陷殺人。究竟包公最後如何為他洗脫冤情?

programme.title: 小英雄 / Little Hero
programme.desc: 主角小雜種由隱士撫養並授以武術；一天，隱士囑他下山訪尋父母。途中，他體驗到人情冷暖，先與女乞丐小乙惺惺相惜，建立「同是天涯淪落人」的友 誼，亦與邑紳之子顧英豪結怨。最後，他終於從妓院鴇母口中得知自己的身世，原來其生母本在顧家為婢，被老爺引誘成姦後，又遭虐待致死….

programme.title: 金石情 / Forever And Ever
programme.desc: 劉貞蓮不幸身患麻瘋，其父劉員外招贅窮書生李孝文為婿，意圖賣瘋傳毒。貞蓮將真相和盤托出，孝文感於貞蓮真情，決意回鄉稟明母親，迎接貞蓮返家。孝文走後，貞蓮萬念俱灰，竟狂飲毒酒，以圖自盡...

programme.title: 錦衣衛 / Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: 明朝時，英宗昏庸無能，大權落入劉永飾的宦官之手，他利用锦衣衛誅殺異己；然梁家仁飾的锦衣衛統領卻義釋忠良。其父在宦官脅迫下被迫追殺親子...

programme.title: 烏龍濟公 / The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: 濟公與修道成仙的呂洞賓鬥智鬥法，二人使出渾身解數，不論是笑聲、法力、風流韻事，甚至乎兵器，雙方都不惜一切對決到底！.

programme.title: 女俠黑蝴蝶 / The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: 平時表現得不諳武術的酒鋪女子關寶珠，原來是武功了得且專門鋤強扶弱的黑蝴蝶。一次黑蝴蝶用從五魔山寨撂奪得來的金子濟貧，令她被黑白二道追捕。.

programme.title: 狂戀詩 / Summer Heat
programme.desc: 大偉和小春是同胞兄弟，一個放浪，一個含蓄。小春在舞會邂逅女子珠迪，情心一片。大偉發現珠迪有個年老丈夫，得知此秘密，大偉以此威脅，迫珠迪和他幽會，自始珠迪周旋三個男人之間... 導演以女性角度大膽描寫男女情關，手法細膩，而結局亦出人意表。.

programme.title: 邊城三俠 / The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: 一群受知縣壓迫的農民綁架了官員的女兒，試圖藉此引起當局的重視。此時，一位流浪劍客伸出援手，與兩位曾是壓迫者、後來淪為被壓迫者的俠士攜手合作，三人聯手反抗知縣的暴行！.

programme.title: 鑽石艷盜 / The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: 兩大珠寶盜賊「夜來香」和「夜爵士」前往日本，意圖偷去「維納斯的眼淚」巨鑽。二人見面後即墜入愛河，卻不知道原來對方同為盜取巨鑽的競敵。最後誰會得到巨鑽？二人的戀情又會否無疾而終？.

programme.title: 鑽石艷盜 / The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: 兩大珠寶盜賊「夜來香」和「夜爵士」前往日本，意圖偷去「維納斯的眼淚」巨鑽。二人見面後即墜入愛河，卻不知道原來對方同為盜取巨鑽的競敵。最後誰會得到巨鑽？二人的戀情又會否無疾而終？.

programme.title: 蔡李佛小子 / The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: 年青馬車伕鍾堅因救助少女而與惡霸結怨。馬車老闆恐惹禍上身，把他辭退。鍾堅決志除暴安良，隨少林蔡李佛名家習武，向惡勢力挑戰。最後，他將惡霸除掉，令地方歸於平靜。.

programme.title: 阿牛發達記 / Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: 阿牛拾得一袋珠寶，從此富貴。這時，周大叔假意叫他簽約迎娶一名女子，却原來是個陷阱，為的是要賣掉他的房子。最後，可憐的阿牛又回復一貧如洗….

programme.title: 大決鬥 / The Duel
programme.desc: 得知弟弟殺死黑社會頭目後，唐人杰毅然承擔罪責，成為殺手追殺的目標。在江南浪子的協助下，他終於成功復仇，卻驚覺江南浪子正是殺害父親的真兇。.

programme.title: 藍與黑續集 / The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: 劇情承接上集，唐琪結束夜總會歌女生涯，在戰亂中跑遍中國尋找愛人張醒亞，但醒亞卻糾纏於日軍，叛亂分子及將軍的美麗女兒當中。.

programme.title: 江湖三女俠 / Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: 故事講述，胸懷野心的朱天翔得知韓氏三姐妹若蘭、如玫、曉蓮家藏威力驚人的玄鐵神劍，若能奪得，必能戰勝「武林之尊」修德武館，稱霸江湖...

programme.title: 武則天 / Empress Wu
programme.desc: 武則天有傾國之貌，絕世才華，十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人，但太宗死後卻入寺為尼，卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染，生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵，命武則天回宮以制妃子，卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後，更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡，武后臨朝，成為史上第一個女皇帝。.

programme.title: 三闖少林 / Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: 四大家族之一的金虎堡堡主在一次押鏢途中，被四名幪面和尚劫殺。葉青花被懷疑與案有關，遊俠雷迅助友洗脫嫌疑，竟捲入奇案，三闖少林。雷迅找出四名和尚，當眾伏法，以為真相大白；豈料，不久武林又傳出四名和尚到處行兇，雷迅才知道被人利用，引發連場打鬥。.

programme.title: 故都春夢 / Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: 故事源自膾炙人口的《啼笑因緣》，內容描述民國初年，富家子范嘉恕戀上歌女岑逢仙，同時又唯賣藝少女官繡珠及貌似岑的財政廳長女兒賀莉霞所迷戀。張大帥垂涎岑，更姦污了她。嘉恕後得繡珠相助，才從大帥手中救回愛人。.

programme.title: 金燕子 / Golden Swallow
programme.desc: 白衣大俠和黑色醉俠同時愛上女俠金燕子。三人卻聯手對付江湖中的惡勢力。在一場生死對決展開前，金燕子還是遲遲未能作出自己感情的抉擇。.

programme.title: 鬼馬神偷 / The Big Sting
programme.desc: 魯俊谷、張權、於洋三人乃沙煲兄弟，三人合力獲得寶物「雙面神」，不料卻給胡起尾注，將三人毒殺，獨吞「雙面神」。劉永、梁家仁及梁韻蕊是他們的後人，在不打不相識之下重逢，為了完成亡父的遺志，三人齊心向胡偷回寶物。韻蕊早已混入胡家中，色誘胡之子，作為內應查出「雙面神」之收藏地點。永與家仁則扮鬼扮馬，偷天換日，最後偷得雙面神！.

programme.title: 大盜歌王 / The Singing Thief
programme.desc: 一名珠寶神偷棄邪歸正，搖身一變成為夜總會歌手。發生連串搶劫案後，他馬上又成為嫌疑犯。於是，神偷設計捉拿冒認者，最終會否連累自己？.

programme.title: 鳳還巢 / Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: 兵部侍郎程浦將次女雪娥許配予好友之子穆居易，庶室程夫人既憤且惱，對居易訛稱長女雪雁乃雪娥，催促二人早日成親。居易見雪雁貌醜而癡，嚇得留書出走。富豪朱煥然對雪娥心儀已久，趁此良機冒充居易，依期迎親……本片由李香君、金峰分飾男、女主角，配搭新鮮；而蔣光超與莊元庸一胖一瘦的諧趣演出，更令人笑破肚皮。.

分手说爱你 / Break Up Club
programme.desc: Joe 是一个十分懒散的人，但为了与女友 Flora复合，认真地透过神秘网站 BreakUpClub.Asia 来拆散其他情侣，同时私下拍了他们从相恋、分手再复合的故事，交给黄真真导演作为她的电影题材。另一方面，本来打算助 Joe 与 Flora 复合的好友，也与女友闹得情海翻波。可惜 Flora 因工作的关系与型男画家搭上，二人再一次面临分手...

programme.title: 出租家人 / We are Family
programme.desc: 沉迷于演戏的临时演员志光，加入由家聪与立志成为女演员的佩怡一起成立的「出租家人公司」，变成出租临时家人。当他们出演临时家人服务时，发现家庭成员间的复杂关系，并建立更深入的联系。.

programme.title: 12怪盗 / WE12
programme.desc: 地下组织「怪盗公会」一直维持着全球的秩序。组织内有12个天才怪盗各自身怀绝技，独立行事多时，各有各忙，所以默契欠奉。12人必须重新燃起团魂，以完成拯救世界免于灾难的使命。.

programme.title: 降龙大师：魔龙咒 / Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: 龙王被降龙大师封印了五百年，龙王之女为解除父亲的封印，不惜穿越时空，回到五百年前杀掉降龙大师。但她没想到五百年前的龙王与降龙大师竟是生死挚友….

programme.title: 美人鱼 / The Mermaid
programme.desc: 地产大亨计划将海洋保护区改建为新物业，为免美人鱼的秘密栖息地被摧毁，美人鱼珊珊奉命引诱大亨并阻止改建计划。当珊珊的任务失败后，人类和美人鱼之间的终极混战亦无可避免。.

programme.title: 说笑之人 / Stand Up Story
programme.desc: 文少从小已察觉父亲华哥的智力比正常人低，母亲更因此离家出走，留下文少照顾父亲。一次偶然机会，文少迷上了脱口秀。在找寻灵感中，他发现终极的欢笑其实只是苦中作乐，从自己在校时被同学耻笑，到影响全球的世纪疫症，生活之苦也可以是欢笑之源！.

programme.title: 烈探 / Fierce Cop
programme.desc: 警探张荼为救落入人贩之手的儿子，不惜孤身深入敌穴，跨国追击，但却被牵扯进大型儿童拐卖案。在寻找儿子的过程中，他和身份神秘的女子携手捣毁了一个大型国际犯罪集团，上演了一场惊心动魄的绝地生死营救。.

programme.title: 龙虎武师 / Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: 香港动作电影向来以龙虎武师的真功夫蜚声国际。这部纪录片向过去所有的龙虎武师致敬，并用上超过两年时间梳理了海量的影像数据，更采访了无数动作特技演员分享拍摄时的辛酸事迹，当中包括著名武打巨星成龙、甄子丹及洪金宝。.

programme.title: 铁线功夫拳 / Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: 习武多年的梁坤为守护心爱之人本不愿再过问江湖之事，却因此导致心爱之人惨死，梁坤也就此明白江湖的真意。他最终在丐帮长老苏灿的帮助下重返江湖，力战群寇，成功为爱人报仇雪恨。.

programme.title: 岁月神偷 / Echoes of the Rainbow
programme.desc: 故事围绕着60年代香港家庭罗氏一家四口的生活。父亲是个勤奋的鞋匠，母亲乐观豁达，还有两名儿子，分别是天赋骄人的长子和古怪俏皮的八岁幼子。他们的生活并非一帆风顺，但无论环境变得如何恶劣，一家人总是在艰难时期互相扶持。.

programme.title: 夜守 / Night Watch
programme.desc: 在一次车祸后失忆的王人杰找到夜间警卫的工作。午夜，他准时抵达废弃的大厦上班，却发现三只冤魂如约而至，并揭发了一场复仇计划。究竟这是命运的安排还是邪灵的诅咒？.

programme.title: 龙马精神 / Ride On
programme.desc: 一位生活落魄的武师训练爱马为一匹可表演特技的马，但为抵偿欠债，他可能会失去爱马。武师唯有向疏离多年的女儿求助，两人也因此得到一次和解的机会。.

programme.title: 锁战 / The Locksmith
programme.desc: 锁匠山叔在意外罹患失智症后，收了爱徒程浩仁。浩仁继承了山叔的精湛技艺，精通开锁，甚至青出于蓝。警探刘业信经常请浩仁协助开锁，二人因此成为好友。某天，浩仁偶遇多年未见的旧友，意外揭开了山叔妻子离奇失踪的真相，连串怪事亦随之而来….

programme.title: 龙凤店 / Adventure of the King
programme.desc: 明朝正德皇因违抗母后的意旨不欲娶其貌不扬的番邦公主，加上闻说江南风光如画，决意与臣子微服出宫，却误入江南四大才子的赌局，被骗去所有钱财。流落民间的正德，来到龙凤店并得店主李凤姐怜惜和收留他，继而展开一段奇遇….

programme.title: 龙凤店 / Adventure of the King
programme.desc: 明朝正德皇因违抗母后的意旨不欲娶其貌不扬的番邦公主，加上闻说江南风光如画，决意与臣子微服出宫，却误入江南四大才子的赌局，被骗去所有钱财。流落民间的正德，来到龙凤店并得店主李凤姐怜惜和收留他，继而展开一段奇遇….

programme.title: 歼毒先锋 / Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: 退役军人吴巍和卧底刑警高天明带领特别行动小组勇闯近曼谷的孤岛，从暴徒手中救出人质。但在完成任务并准备离岛之际，吴巍发现自己的女儿被对方胁持。为救女儿及将犯罪分子绳之以法，吴巍和高天明重回危险境地，与暴徒进行了惨烈的对决。.

programme.title: 欧洲攻略 / Europe Raiders
programme.desc: 林先生和王小姐是两大顶尖赏金猎人，同时找寻一颗地震飞弹「上帝之手」。原本以为只是赏金猎人间之较量，但过程中却发现还有其他特工正全力搜捕。他们二人最后可解除误会，连手抗敌找出「上帝之手」吗？.

programme.title: 红毯先生 / The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: 刘伟驰是一位渴望赢得电影奖项的香港天王巨星。他与导演林浩合作拍摄以中国农村为题材的影片，希望在国际电影节能赢得荣誉。于是，刘伟驰为农夫的角色体验当地乡村生活，结果却是笑话连篇的一场闹剧。.

programme.title: 西游记之孙悟空三打白骨精 / The Monkey King 2
programme.desc: 孙悟空受命于观音娘娘，护送唐僧取西经。途中遇到性感美艶兼法力高强的白骨精，要吃下洁净躯体的唐僧以求长生不老。孙悟空为保护唐僧，将与白骨精展开连场激战！.

programme.title: 金手指 / The Goldfinger
programme.desc: 电影取材自80年代香港最大宗的财经丑闻，讲述程一言由一个寂寂无名的小喽啰一跃而成为亿万富豪，并担任上市公司主席的故事。然而，当程一言的财富疯狂飙升，势力日益壮大时，廉署高级调查主任刘启源决定介入调查，即使花了长达15年时间，也誓要找出真相。.

programme.title: L风暴 / L Storm
programme.desc: 廉政公署首席调查主任陆志廉与总督察刘保强分别侦查贪污及洗黑钱案，但苦无线索。陆志廉因洗黑钱集团诬陷而被控受贿。为表清白，他不惜冒生命危险搜集洗黑钱集团的罪证。.

programme.title: 瞒天过海 / The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: 年轻貌美的企业家乔文娜被控为一宗密室杀人案的疑凶，而死者正是她的情夫。乔文娜找来一名警察协助她洗脱罪名，调查期间他们揭发另一牵涉乔文娜和她情夫的凶杀案，真相逐渐浮出水面。.

programme.title: 婚前试爱 / Marriage With A Liar
programme.desc: 琪琪与拍拖七年的男友阿泽在一星期后便结婚，他们却在婚前三天双双出轨。这对年轻情侣各自面对自己完美的新伴侣，抛开一切责任，走上了各自的爱情岔路….

programme.title: 不是你不爱你 / Love at First Lie
programme.desc: 那年暑假，性格开朗善良的平凡少女阿宝偶遇不务正业的富家子家伟。为报复父亲再婚，家伟聘用阿宝及其好友等人捣乱婚礼，促成他与阿宝认识并开始交往。两人情投意合，尝尽热恋甜蜜，岂料命运却为这段爱情安排了急转直下的暗涌….

programme.title: 把幸福拉近一点 / Wish Comes True
programme.desc: 被母亲抛弃但依然性格开朗的少女小菲，偶遇身患罕见病症、才华横溢的年轻男子子威，两人因此结下不解之缘。小菲决心帮助子威寻回失去的爱人，过程中却发现子威长期等待的治疗新药竟无效。尽管遭受沉重打击，两人依然决心携手，用爱与希望点亮彼此的生命。.

programme.title: 焚城 / Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: 因非法偷运废料引发的一场大火，香港陷入辐射泄漏危机。为了应对这场毁灭性的灾难，专家范伟立加入由署理行政长官领导的紧急应变小组。一支消防队伍临危受命，深入辐射区，拼尽全力阻止辐射扩散。在面对前所未见的浩劫时，他们能否拯救这座城市？.

programme.title: S风暴 / S Storm
programme.desc: 廉政公署首席调查主任陆志廉在调查非法足球搏彩集团时目击嫌疑犯被杀。重案组督察刘保强急需陆志廉的口供，但因廉署的保密守则，陆志廉无法提供任何线索，阻碍刘保强的调查。二人由调查开始时的互不信任，到最后发展出默契，誓要将犯罪集团连根拔起。.

programme.title: Soul Mate
programme.desc: Qiyue and Ansheng are two high school best friends. Qiyue is calm like water while Ansheng is a fiery ball of passion. As fate would have it, they fall in love with the same man, Jia-ming. Because of their different values and lifestyles, they are destined to arrive at two completely different endings..

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: It was 1917, China. CHENG was an innocent young man who worked in a grocery store and had no ambition, other than to be with his lovely neighbour, the Peking Opera student QIU. But a fateful night had changed Cheng's life forever, as he literally walked right in the affair between his lady boss and the chief of police. To hide this secret, the chief decided to throw Cheng into prison, accusing him of raping his lady boss. Desolated, Cheng met a cellmate MAO, who happened to have an escape plan. The duo broke out, and Cheng had no choice but to leave his life, and his dream girl behind..

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: Min-ho's adulterous lover Se-hee is murdered in the hotel where the two of them spent time together. Apart from Min-ho, there is no trace of anyone else having been there. Immediately singled out as the prime suspect, Min-ho maintains his innocence, and he hires the lawyer Shin-ae, who has a 100% record of victory in court, to defend him. In order to prove his innocence, she asks Min-ho to confess to her the entire truth. He admits that a car accident that they were in the day before the murder may be connected in some way to Se-hee's death.

programme.title: Fragments of the Last Will
programme.desc: In 1945, after the end of World War II, Hatao Yamamoto was imprisoned in a concentration camp in Sibera, Russia. Despite the harsh, despairing condition in the camp, Hatao Yamamoto kept telling other prisoners not to give up hope, and that the day when they could all go back home would come. Hatao Yamamoto firmly believed that he would return to Japan and meet his wife, Mojimi Yamamoto, and their children someday. 8 years after the war, he received a postcard from his wife with a one-line message written on it, stating that “We are waiting for you to come back”. Meanwhile, Hatao Yamamoto's health was deteriorating rapidly. After having a diagnosis, the doctor told him that he had only three months left... After listening to his friends' advices, he decided to write a will and left it to his friends to bring it to his family when they were released. However, the will was seen as a spying message by the officers in the concentration camp and was confiscated..

programme.title: The Plot
programme.desc: Young-il is a plotter who manipulates murder-for-hire cases to look like accidents. Nobody knows those accidents are in fact perfectly plotted, planned murders. After finishing a flawlessly plotted case with no trace of evidence left behind, Young-il receives a new request. His new target is a prominent political figure who is always under the spotlight. Even with the higher risk of getting exposed, Young-il decides to take the case with his team members, Jackie, Wol-cheon, and Jeom-man. When the plot is ready after immaculate preparation and numerous rehearsals, the team finally makes its move, but some unexpected trouble threatens Young-il's perfect plan.

programme.title: Needing You
programme.desc: Kinki is transferred to Andy's division due to 'office politics'. Rumors have it that Andy is womanizer and Kinki is unwilling to work with him! However, life is mysterious..

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: Secondary school teacher Lam Yiu-kwok is suffering from a mid-life crisis - his peers have all become more successful than him; his relationship with his wife, Chan Man-ching, is in trouble when her old flame returns, and he finds himself tempted by a 17-year-old student who has a crush on him..

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Beyond The Dream
programme.desc: Lok (Lau Chun Him) is a recovering schizophrenic who yearns for love. One day, he encounters the young and beautiful Yan (Cecilia Choi) and quickly falls in love with her. Just when he struggles whether to tell her about his illness, he has a relapse and becomes delusional. Little does he know that she is a psychological counselor who has a hidden agenda. The pair develops a relationship that is beyond their wildest dreams.

programme.title: Them, Behind the Door
programme.desc: A young mother and her child move into Room 606 of the infamous Butterfly Mansion, a notorious haunted building in the heart of Taipei. From the moment they arrive, eerie paranormal events begin to unfold, pushing her to uncover the dark secrets lurking within its walls. Amid the chaos, the building's new janitor-a kind and seemingly helpful young man-offers his support. But behind his warm smile lies a mystery of his own. As their paths intertwine, she realizes that everyone carries their own shadows, and the deeper she digs, the closer she gets to a chilling revelation. In Butterfly Mansion, the greatest lesson she learns is this: Humans Are More Terrifying Than Ghosts.

programme.title: Weeds on Fire
programme.desc: In the year of 1984, the Sino-British Joint Declaration was signed, and the future of Hong Kong became unclear. In the stream of history, this story of a baseball team beneath the Lion Rock had gradually been forgotten. In that year, 'Shatin Martins', the first Hong Kong youth baseball team, was formed. The 10 young players were living an uneasy and restless life as Hong Kong was being humiliated by one defeat after another and the fate of the 'Shatin Martins'..

programme.title: Lonely Eighteen
programme.desc: This is a story about how family can impact the growth of a young woman. It follows Elaine, who grew up in poverty in the 1980's, and her best friend Ying as they enter the Hong Kong entertainment industry to change their fate. In the golden era of Hong Kong cinema, Ying becomes a popular erotic star while Elaine struggles between her identity and her job as an actor. When Hong Kong cinema's glory fades a decade later, the two women end up on diverging paths due to their life choices.

programme.title: Keep Rolling
programme.desc: On a buzzing red carpet, a 70-year-old short-haired woman strides towards the stage with confidence. Behind the red carpet, it's a muddy path that leads to a movie studio in New Territories, Hong Kong. To her, glory and hardship are nothing more than just different paths that lead to the world of cinema. Born in Northeastern China, raised in Macau and educated in Hong Kong, Ann Hui stays true to her cultural heritage as a Chinese, yet she has always been fascinated by Western literature and therefore decided to further her studies in London. Eventually, she found movies. Through movies, she becomes fully immersed into the ‘East-meets-West' culture and lifestyle of Hong Kong; She reconciles with her distant mother; And she gets to explore the cultural and social identity of her and the city she calls home. Movies also found her. Having learned from veteran auteur King Hu, her directorial debut became part of the impetus behind Hong Kong's New Wave as she explores marginalize.

programme.title: Manhunt
programme.desc: Manhunt follows the journey of upstanding lawyer Du Qiu, who is unwittingly drawn into a murder case when all the evidence at the scene points to him being the perpetrator. Knowing that he's been framed by Luo Zhi, Du Qiu runs from the law to uncover the truth. The police launch a large-scale manhunt, but veteran detective Yamura sees that this seemingly open-and-shut case is not that simple after all. During the intense pursuit, a bond begins to build between the fugitive and his pursuer, even though Yamura knows that he can't fully trust Du Qiu. Is the real killer lurking elsewhere? Is there a hidden conspiracy behind the murder.

programme.title: Exhuma
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, the renowned shaman Hwa-rim and her protege Bong-gil are commissioned with a hefty sum to meet the enigmatic descendants of a household afflicted by a peculiar illness. Sensing the ominous aura surrounding the ancestral grave, Hwa-rim urges for its relocation. The best geomancer in the business, Sang-duk, and mortician Young-geun, lured by the scent of money, join the team. The mysterious grave, situated in an unapproachable sacred ground, holds dark secrets. Though Sang-duk senses an ominous presence and initially rejects the proposal, Hwa-rim's persuasion ultimately initiates the exhumation, leading to a journey where the team must confront both supernatural forces and their own fears.

programme.title: Turning Point 2
programme.desc: To undertake the ending of TV drama “Lives of Omission”, Laughing is sentenced to life-imprisonment for killing Michael. In the prison, Laughing got to know Professor Fok, an introvert serving his sentence for drug-dealing. Professor Fok is a gifted psychologist who reads mind: discovering the deepest, darkest secrets of others, thus enabling him to manipulate and control others. Laughing learns more of psychology and he holds a strong admiration for Professor Fok. But in fact, Professor Fok has an ulterior motive. Laughing, confirming his imprisonment is all part of a new secret mission, the Security Bureau wants Laughing to infiltrate in prison to investigate further for the suspected corrupted cops..

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: To raise funds for his father, Sanqing, who has faced social ostracism, goes undercover at the Life Hotel near the hospital, aiming to disrupt its operations and coerce owner Xiao Lin into agreeing to its demolition. However, as they spend time together, Sanqing forms bonds with the hotel's residents and learns of the guests' life stories. His internal conflict escalates, turning a simple undercover assignment into a matter of personal integrity. The hotel's destiny impacts not only its inhabitants but also Sanqing's longing for home. Yet, his indecision triggers a deeper crisis..

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Abandoned by her mother, Xiaofei, a positive and cheerful girl, encounters a 'Wish Come True Machine' that can fulfil people's wishes, and forms a bond with a young talent named Wai who suffers from a rare disease. While Xiaofei is finding the lost lover of Wai, it is discovered that the new medicine for treating Wai's rare disease is ineffective. However, life affects life. Although Xiaofei and Wai are hit hard by fate, they decided to continue their love and hope.

programme.title: Accident
programme.desc: A self-styled “accident choreographer,” the Brain is a professional hitman who kills his victims by trapping them in well crafted “accidents” that look like unfortunate mishaps but are in fact perfectly staged acts of crime. Perennially plagued with guilt, he is also suspicious and morbid by nature. The recent avalanche of memories of his lost wife does not make things any easier. After one mission accidentally goes wrong, causing the life of one of his men, the Brain is convinced that this accident has been choreographed: someone is out there plotting to terminate him and his team. He becomes increasingly paranoid, walking on the thin line between reality and delusion..

programme.title: At the End of the Matinee
programme.desc: The story begins with the meeting of classical guitarist Satoshi Makino and female journalist Yoko Komine. They are both in their 40's, a unique and delicate time in their lives... They are drawn to each other from the start, but Yoko is engaged to be married. Their jobs take them all over the globe. Powerless against the tides of time, missed opportunities and unexpected obstacles bring their relationship to an end. Memories of each other are locked deep in their hearts as they continue on separate paths. Will fate ever bring them back together again...

programme.title: Love On A Diet
programme.desc: Mini Mo becomes an fatty when her boyfriend went abroad ten years ago. She meets Fatso in the time of adversity. When Fatso learns the true story behind Mini's depression..

programme.title: Baogu Produces
programme.desc: Sandra Ng and MC (Cheung Tin Fu) grow a virtual romance in the film “Love Lies” which the script has revolved around online dating scam. What inspired the production team to make such a tale of love and deceit? And how the main cast of two initially unlikable people was chosen? The film director Ho Miu Ki and producer Chan Hing Ka are invited hereby to tell us more about this romantic comedy..

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: 'Love, once believed, is real.' Despite being swindled out of a large sum of money, the well-known gynecologist Yu still insisted that she was in love. Yu, who had been widowed for several years, met Joe, who was disguised as a middle-aged French petroleum engineer and widower, on a dating app, not knowing that he was part of an online scam group. Not only was Yu immersed in the online romance, but Joe also found pleasure and satisfaction in creating romantic experiences for Yu. Two initially unlikable people gradually changed through this online romance that began with deception.

Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. programme.title: Ore 15:17 - Attacco al treno
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.title: La zona d'interesse
programme.desc: Premio a Cannes e 2 Oscar per l'intensa opera di Jonathan Glazer. Un solo muro separa la quiete borghese della famiglia del comandante di Auschwitz dal campo di concentramento.

programme.title: Eterno visionario
programme.desc: Fabrizio Bentivoglio e Valeria Bruni Tedeschi nel biopic che racconta vita e arte di Luigi Pirandello. Il ritratto intimo del grande drammaturgo e la cronaca della sua esistenza, scandita dal rapporto burrascoso con la moglie e dall'amore per una giovane musa.

programme.title: Un eroe
programme.desc: Grand Prix della Giuria a Cannes per il pluripremiato Asghar Farhadi. Un detenuto rinuncia a una borsa piena d'oro restituendola al proprietario. Diventera' un eroe ma con esiti imprevisti.

programme.title: Provaci ancora, Sam
programme.desc: Una commedia scritta e interpretata da Woody Allen, con Diane Keaton. Un critico cinematografico, goffo con le donne, chiede aiuto al fantasma di Humphrey Bogart per sedurre la bella Linda.

programme.title: La vita accanto
programme.desc: Marco Tullio Giordana dirige una pellicola con Sonia Bergamasco e Paolo Pierobon. La nascita di Rebecca, con una macchia rossa sul viso, getta nello sconforto una ricca famiglia.

programme.title: Amistad
programme.desc: Il grande Steven Spielberg dirige i premi Oscar Anthony Hopkins e Morgan Freeman in un appassionante dramma storico-giudiziario. 1839: un gruppo di schiavi, imbarcati sulla nave Amistad per essere venduti, si ribellano e uccidono parte dell'equipaggio tentando il dirottamento verso l'Africa. Giunti su un'isola verranno pero' attaccati da una nave americana rischiando di essere schiavizzati ancora. Seconda nomination agli Oscar per Anthony Hopkins nel ruolo di un Presidente degli Stati Uniti (qui interpreta John Q. Adams) dopo quella ottenuta per "Nixon".

programme.title: Ore 15:17 - Attacco al treno
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: 2 Oscar 2018 al sequel del cult di fantascienza diretto da Denis Villeneuve con Harrison Ford e Ryan Gosling. L’agente K scopre un segreto che potrebbe gettare il mondo nel caos.

programme.title: Il tenente ottomano
programme.desc: L'amore in tempo di guerra in un dramma con Ben Kingsley e Josh Hartnett. Alla vigilia della Grande Guerra, un'infermiera lascia l'America per una missione medica nell'Impero turco.

programme.title: Un giorno di ordinaria follia
programme.desc: Viaggio allucinato nella follia omicida di un uomo qualunque con Michael Douglas. Il quarantenne William Foster non sta passando un momento facile: lasciato dalla moglie e allontanato dalla figlia in seguito a un'ordinanza del giudice, viene preso da un raptus. Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

programme.desc: David Cronenberg dirige Viggo Mortensen in un thriller fra apparenza e realtà. Dopo aver ucciso 2 rapinatori per legittima difesa, un uomo si trova braccato da loschi individui.

programme.desc: The series is based on the graphic novel created by Carlo J. Caparas. Totoy Bato, a young man, fighting for justice for his lost loved ones; also fighting for equality and fairness against his old friend turned nemesis Dwayne.

programme.title: Team A S2 ep 8
programme.desc: Matapos mapatunayan nila Janet (Kim Molina) at Ian (Jerald Napoles) ang pagmamahalan at diskarte sa kani-kanilang pamilya, ano pa ang mga pagsubok na haharapin ng pamilya Ambida? Ano ang naghihintay sa paglipat nila sa bago nilang komunidad lalo pa at magtatagpo uli si Janet at Enzo (Wilbert Ross), ex boyfriend ni Janet, na tutulong din sa kanilang negosyo? Paano ito haharapin ni Ian sa gitna ng pagkawala ng trabaho?

programme.title: Sari Saring Sine: Kadenang Bulaklak
programme.desc: Jasmin, Baby, Violy and Daisy are siblings who lost their parents Elsa and Domeng in a bus accident after their scheduled out-of-town radio drama performance. Left under the care of young couple Tere and Merto after their parents' death, as they were attempting to start a family of their own. They could only remain guardians for Jasmin, but not her siblings. Jasmin gets separated from her siblings when Father Barrientos sends Baby, Violy and Daisy for adoption.

programme.desc: 1842. Two West Point military academy cadets form a bond of friendship strong enough to survive the forces leading to the United States' Civil War--forces that will rip their country into North and South

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Marple S6 E04 - Greenshaw's Folly (Part 2)
programme.desc: Julia McKenzie perfectly captures Agatha Christie’s iconic amateur detective - and the innocent exterior which harbours a razor- sharp mind.

programme.title: Roots: The Next Generations E10 - The Great Depression (Part 2)
programme.desc: The dramatization of Alex Haley's family line from post Civil War America to the writer's search for his roots.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess S2 E21 - Lost Mariner
programme.desc: Xena, one of the fiercest, sexiest, most self-empowered women as she travels defending the innocent from the forces of darkness. She is the very definition of girl power.

programme.title: Frasier S5 E11 - Ain't Nobody's Business If I Do
programme.desc: This season of FRASIER finds Niles and Frasier competing again, this time over who will find their father Martin the better birthday gift. Meanwhile, Daphne finds her favorite pub invaded by a familiar and unwelcome interloper.

programme.title: Bewitched S6 E12 - Samantha's Double Mother Trouble
programme.desc: Another year of marriage between mortal and witch has the Stephens trying to cope with Samantha's meddling, magical family and their daughter's entrance into nursery school.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Marple S6 E05 - Endless Night (Part 1)
programme.desc: Julia McKenzie perfectly captures Agatha Christie’s iconic amateur detective - and the innocent exterior which harbours a razor- sharp mind.

programme.title: The Waltons S4 E07 - The Wingwalker
programme.desc: As every member of the Walton family strives to follow his or her dreams during the hard years of the Depression, each finds the bonds of family -- which at times seem stifling -- to be their greatest source of strength in this heartwarming dramatic series about growing up in a rural Appalachian family.

programme.title: Unkind Ladies
programme.desc: This drama features the women of three generations and people around them. Mari grows up as a good teacher of this generation where there is no true mentor. Hyeonsuk, who has been a troublemaker, realizes the love and support of her family. Kang Sunok regards herself as unlucky, but later on realizes how happy she has been. How can you hold up when your life gets tough? You will figure it out by holding up day by day, just like these women in the drama.

programme.title: KBS World News Today
programme.desc: KBS World Daily English News Anchor : Choi Kyu-yeon

programme.title: Music Bank K-Chart
programme.desc: Follow the latest trend in the Korean music scene through the K-chart, a summary of the week's hottest songs.

programme.title: Music Bank
programme.desc: The best tunes in Korea! the most sensational music show on TV satisfies all your senses! Fantastic performances and Awe-inspiring harmony by the nation's top musicians! Follow the latest trend in the Korean music scene through the K-chart, a summary of the week's hottest songs.

programme.title: The Dropout Employee
programme.desc: A company's flagship idol is seemingly abandoned(?) by their own agency! Stepping away from life as a popular idol, the new journey begins.

programme.title: Glaciers
programme.desc: Glaciers possess a very special kind of “power.” They have acted as a catalyst for the birth and evolution of life on Earth. Glaciers are the source of human life and one of the most important partners in the Earth's climate system. However, due to global warming, glaciers are gradually disappearing. What, then, is happening to glaciers? This documentary explores what we must do to prevent the disappearance of glaciers, which may threaten the future of the Earth.

programme.title: The Best of Immortal Songs
programme.desc: The true classic of the century is born again! The legendary classic is reinterpreted by the best vocalists in Korea. Don't miss out on the heart-moving moments that transcend generations.

programme.title: My Neighbor, Charles
programme.desc: Foreigners who have left their familiar worlds behind and come to the unfamiliar land of Korea! A vivid, real-life adaptation story of foreigners trying to settle into Korean society for various reasons. This reality program warmly portrays their concerns about jobs, marriage, and parenting while living in Korea.

programme.title: Marie and Her Three Daddies
programme.desc: Marie's turbulent journey to find her father leads to the birth of an eccentric new family, one that proves stronger than blood and more persistent than DNA.

programme.title: A Graceful Liar
programme.desc: A bold yet heartbreaking story of a mother and daughter-in-law who meet through marriage and wage a war of lies to seize the Geonhyang family, struggling for a dramatic reversal of fortune.

programme.title: Oh My Venus
programme.desc: A love story between Kim Youngho, a flawless personal trainer struggling to overcome his childhood injury, and Kang Jueun, who used to be an icon of first love but is just an overweight lawyer now.
